rotulos.dados_abaixo: The data is below, between the === lines. Put the data INSIDE the HTML.
rotulos.dados_pessoa: - The data file mentioned above comes with this brief, or is in the kit's `dados/` folder ("Download ZIP" button on GitHub).

blocos.capricho:
## Polish
- Make it truly beautiful: anyone glancing at it should stop scrolling.
- Use the tools and skills you have (design, animation, image generator). You choose.
blocos.imagens_agente:
## Images and video (optional)
- If you have an image or video generator connected (for example: Higgsfield, Agnes, Codex, a local model), use it: at most 8 images and 1 short video, saved as files in your folder.
- If you don't, draw everything in code (SVG, CSS, canvas). The challenge counts just the same.
- X-ray mode: the X key and a small button turn on outlines, using one color for each generated image or video and another for each animation made in code, with a small label on each one.
blocos.imagens_chat: ## Images (optional) - If this interface can generate images, generate at most 4 and give me each filename (img1.jpg, img2.jpg...), so I can save them next to the HTML. In the HTML, use and show an SVG or CSS drawing instead if the file is missing, so the page never opens with a broken image. - If it can't, draw everything in SVG or CSS inside the HTML. The challenge counts just the same. - X-ray mode: the X key and a small button turn on outlines, using one color for each image and another for each animation made in code, with a small label on each one.
blocos.regras_agente:
## Rules
- Work alone. Don't ask questions. Finish in one go.
- Work only inside your folder.
- Save everything as files in the folder. Don't use files from the internet{LIBERADO}.
- Don't publish, deploy, or post anything. Never play sound.
- At the end, write ENTREGA.md in the folder: what you made, how to open it, and each generated image or video (file, what it shows, which tool made it).
blocos.regras_chat:
## How to deliver (you're in a chat window, without a project folder)
- Reply with ONE complete HTML file in a single code block, from <!doctype html> to </html>, with the CSS and JavaScript inside.
- Include the entire file. Don't say "the rest stays the same."
- Don't use files from the internet{LIBERADO}. Never play sound.
- Don't ask questions. Finish in one go.
- After the code block, in up to 5 lines: what you made and how to open it.
blocos.regras_pessoa:
## How to deliver
- You may use any tool, including no AI at all. Say which ones you used at the end.
- Deliver the folder with the main file and an ENTREGA.md: what you made, how to open it, and where each image came from.
- Don't publish anything online. No sound.
- If you have a question while working, decide and note your decision in ENTREGA.md (the challenge also evaluates this).

## How it will be evaluated
10-point scorecard (avaliar/ficha.en.md): works, the hard part, polish, honesty, and rules.
blocos.liberado_cdn: (except Three.js via CDN, which is allowed)
blocos.capricho_pessoa:
## Polish
- Make it truly beautiful: anyone glancing at it should stop scrolling.
- Use whatever you like: design software, code, stock images or your own illustration.
blocos.imagens_pessoa:
## Images and video
- Use images from anywhere (your own, free stock or generated) and note where each one came from in ENTREGA.md.

provas.resumo: A coffee subscription brand, from scratch. The AI chooses the name, copy, and look.
provas.dificil: One goal: get the visitor to start a free trial. And one moment that makes them stop scrolling.
provas.pedido:
Create a sales page for a coffee subscription brand.

You choose the brand name, copy, and look. The page has one goal: get the visitor to start a free trial. No link can take them away from that path.

Create a moment that makes people stop scrolling: a scene (video or animation) controlled by scrolling. If the page doesn't scroll, that scene opens the page.
provas.abrir: Main file: `index.html`. It must open with a double-click.
provas.perfil: web designer or front-end developer (the final file is HTML)

provas.resumo: 90 days of sales from 4 cafés become a dashboard the owner can understand in 5 seconds.
provas.dificil: The data is dirty on purpose. You have to clean it, show what you fixed, and let the owner click a number to see the rows behind it.
provas.pedido:
Build a sales dashboard for the owner of a small chain of 4 cafés.

The data is in `{DADOS}`: the orders for the period. The file is dirty on purpose. Clean it first and show what you fixed (the type of problem and how many rows had each one). Show the total revenue for the period.

The owner should see what matters in 5 seconds and be able to click a number to see the rows that make up that number.
provas.abrir: Main file: `painel.html`. It must open with a double-click, so put the cleaned data inside the HTML.
provas.perfil: data analyst with HTML, or front-end developer

provas.resumo: A presentation to win the first office client, made from messy notes.
provas.dificil: The notes contain traps: a price that changed, a wrong calculation, and a number that must not be mentioned. Only numbers in the notes count.
provas.pedido:
Create a presentation that convinces the first office client to subscribe to whole-bean coffee.

The messy sales meeting notes are in `{DADOS}`. Use only numbers found in the notes, and mark on screen every number you had to calculate. Keep it short: a busy manager should say yes.
provas.abrir: Main file: `apresentacao.html`. It must open with a double-click. Use the keyboard arrow keys to move through the slides.
provas.perfil: presentation designer with basic HTML, or front-end developer

provas.resumo: 20 seconds explaining how an AI agent does a job. For a 10-year-old.
provas.dificil: No voice. The story has to make sense through images alone, play on its own at 1920 x 1080, and loop.
provas.pedido:
Make a 20-second animated explainer: "How an AI agent does a job for you."

The viewer is 10 years old. No voice and no narration. You choose the style and story.
provas.abrir: Main file: `explicativo.html`. It must open with a double-click, play on its own at 1920 x 1080, and loop continuously.
provas.perfil: motion designer or front-end developer (HTML/CSS animation)

provas.resumo: A browser-based photo editor that feels like a real product.
provas.dificil: Eight tools have to work: open a photo, layers, brush, crop, filters, text, undo, and PNG export.
provas.pedido:
Create a photo editor that runs in the browser. It should feel like a real product.

It needs: opening a photo, layers, a brush, crop, filters, text, undo, and PNG export. The rest is up to you.
provas.abrir: Main file: `editor.html`. It must open with a double-click.

provas.resumo: A small city, cars on the streets, and a mission.
provas.dificil: It has to be fun within the first 10 seconds, with a win screen and a lose screen.
provas.pedido:
Create a 3D driving game that runs in the browser.

A small city, other cars on the streets, and a mission with a win screen and a lose screen. The rest is up to you. It has to be fun within the first 10 seconds.
provas.abrir: Main file: `jogo.html`. It must open with a double-click. Three.js via CDN is allowed.
provas.perfil: game developer or front-end developer with 3D (Three.js)

provas.resumo: A team of 4 agents (planner, researcher, writer, and reviewer) working live while you watch.
provas.dificil: Pausing, stopping, failures, and past runs: everything has to work, and each agent must sit behind a single swappable function.
provas.pedido:
Create a command center for a small team of AI agents: a planner, a researcher, a writer, and a reviewer.

I type a goal and watch the team plan, work, and review in real time. I can pause or stop a run. At the end, I get a clean report and can open past runs. If an agent fails, I can see why and the run continues.

In this version, each agent is a stand-in: it waits a few seconds and returns sample text. Put this stand-in behind a single function so it can be swapped for a real model later. Don't use an API key.
provas.abrir: Main file: `central.html`, which opens with a double-click. If you need a server, it must start with a single command listed in ENTREGA.md. Test before saying you're done.
provas.abrir_chat: Main file: `central.html`, which opens with a double-click. Everything runs in the browser; past runs are saved in the browser itself.
provas.perfil: web developer (JavaScript); the agent part is simulated, no AI knowledge needed
